The issue in the provided code is that the calculation of the number of components with a single element is incorrect. The current code sums the sizes of all components that have exactly one element, which is not the intended behavior. Instead, it should count the number of such components.

Here is the patch to fix the issue:

# modification 1
```
<file>faultyVersion.java</file>
<original>
		// 要素数1の連結成分が二つ以上あるなら、数えない
		int one = IntStream.range(0, N).filter(i -> dsu.getSize(i) == 1).sum(); // faultLocation.txt identifies this line as the provided fault location. It is used because Ochiai fault localization is unavailable.
</original>
<patched>
		// 要素数1の連結成分が二つ以上あるなら、数えない
		int one = (int) IntStream.range(0, N).filter(i -> dsu.getSize(i) == 1).count();
</patched>
```

This change ensures that `one` correctly represents the number of components with exactly one element, rather than summing their sizes. This should resolve the issue where the rank of person 15 was incorrectly determined as -1.
